body.content: Contradiction: If 'redundancy' in a monolith is achieved by duplicating the same software stack on different hardware, is it actually different from a decentralized network of small services using the same stack? The 'Monolith' vs 'Decentralized' distinction might be a red herring; the real axis is 'Stack Diversity' vs 'Stack Homogeneity'.
body.why_keep_this: Challenges the binary premise of the problem.
